name: runtime-asset-tracker
description: Track Docker images, containers, volumes, Compose operations, and deployments with portable labels and an append-only JSONL ledger.

interface.shortDescription: Label and trace Docker assets across projects.
interface.longDescription: A cross-project runtime asset console with an MCP Apps dashboard, portable Docker labels, append-only lifecycle ledger, cleanup previews, and Linux/Windows observers. It tracks and classifies assets without introducing release approval gates.
defaultPrompt: Open the runtime asset dashboard and show what is reclaimable.
Preview safe Docker cleanup without deleting anything.
Show recent runtime asset events across projects.
